```yaml
name: Dependabot Auto Merge

on:
  pull_request_target:
    types: [opened, synchronize]
    branches: [main]
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ["Only CI/CT"]
    types: [completed]

jobs:
  auto_merge:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up JDK 11
        uses: actions/setup-java@v2
        with:
          java-version: '11'
          distribution: 'adopt'

      - name: Cache Maven packages
        uses: actions/cache@v2
        with:
          path: ~/.m2/repository
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-m2-${{ hashFiles('**/pom.xml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-m2-

      - name: Run integration tests
        run: mvn verify

      - name: Get PR information
        id: pr_info
        run: echo "::set-output name=pr_number::$GITHUB_EVENT_NUMBER"

      - name: Check if PR is from Dependabot
        id: dependabot_check
        run: echo "::set-output name=is_dependabot::${{ github.event.pull_request.user.login == 'dependabot[bot]' }}"

      - name: Wait for 5 seconds
        run: sleep 5

      - name: Get PR checks
        id: get_checks
        run: |
          PR_CHECKS=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" https://api.github.com/repos/${{ github.repository }}/pulls/${{ steps.pr_info.outputs.pr_number }}/checks?per_page=100)
          echo "::set-output name=check_runs::$PR_CHECKS"

      - name: Parse PR checks
        id: parse_checks
        run: |
          CHECK_RUNS=$(echo ${{ steps.get_checks.outputs.check_runs }} | jq '.check_runs[] | select(.status == "completed")')
          echo "::set-output name=completed_checks::$CHECK_RUNS"

      - name: Validate checks
        id: validate_checks
        run: |
          COMPLETED_CHECKS=${{ steps.parse_checks.outputs.completed_checks }}
          if [[ -z "$COMPLETED_CHECKS" ]]; then
            echo "No completed checks found."
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "All checks completed successfully."

      - name: Approve and merge PR
        if: ${{ steps.dependabot_check.outputs.is_dependabot == 'true' && steps.validate_checks.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: |
          gh pr review --approve --merge ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
```

This workflow will automatically merge Dependabot PRs when they pass the integration tests. It includes dual triggers (`pull_request_target` and `workflow_run`) to ensure robustness. The validation logic filters Dependabot PRs, checks their statuses, and merges them if all checks pass. Safety mechanisms such as waiting for 5 seconds after the workflow run and preventing duplicate approvals are also implemented.
